quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay on the right side of the road. It warns of a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A traffic light is coming up ahead. Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is changing direction or getting narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign alerts drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must yield the right-of-way at this sign. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross before you continue. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep hill is coming up. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a road is joining from the right ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to be careful when the road is wet because the pavement becomes slippery.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may become slippery when wet.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: A pentagon-shaped sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to school zones. It warns of areas where children may cross the road.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: When you see this sign, it means:

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. Multiple chevrons may be placed throughout a curve.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that cyclists may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign is a warning that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks to tell drivers to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws you must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Stop and wait until the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?

options.text: You can turn right at a red light.

questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control signs in work zones.

questions.question: This sign means you are approaching a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep the same speed and look and listen for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At this type of railroad crossing, slow down and check for trains in both directions. Listen carefully and be prepared to stop. Never try to race a train across the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in one direction only.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign tells you that the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in one direction only.
Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards just ahead. This sign warns you that traffic will merge from the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and stop only if other cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
You can proceed carefully without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed here. Regulation signs show rules that drivers must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you of a steep hill coming up. Slow down to avoid crashes and to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road will curve to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction areas. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. It tells drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the divided road is ending. Traffic will soon move in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of an area with low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a divided highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill section or hill ahead. It may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This is a triangular Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let other vehicles, pedestrians, and cross traffic pass before you go. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will be slippery when wet. Slow down.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows a steep downhill grade ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you proceed.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign indicates a:
questions.explanation: Round signs with yellow and black markings warn of railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: This sign is used to prevent:

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only goes one way. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead. You will need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It tells drivers to watch for a side road entering the main road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It tells drivers that the road ahead curves back and forth. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead turns at a sharp angle. Slow down before you reach the turn, just like you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a sharp right turn coming up.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It alerts you to watch for vehicles entering your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers of work zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. Obey the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You might damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You might hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You might lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You might lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers of upcoming hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and against the law to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to situations ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare to turn or watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services available to drivers, such as rest areas, food, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street in the wrong direction.
You can go if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street in the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign, traffic is coming at you. Turn around if you are driving toward it.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of an upcoming winding road with three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your normal speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction or maintenance work is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction or maintenance work is ahead.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn drivers of work zones. This sign means you are entering a construction area. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a neighborhood.
The safe speed for an expressway exit.
The safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for exiting a highway (in this example, 30 mph).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down and steer safely through the curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown.
This lane is for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: You are going the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
You cannot go until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Then yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway begins. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right and shows the safe speed to drive through the curve (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; the road curves ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is allowed only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the roadway. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves at slow speeds. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows drivers which direction to drive when entering a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. A red circle with a slash through a right turn arrow means no right turn is allowed.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. If you are following this driver, adjust your driving to expect a right turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: One lane is ending. Move to the left.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending. Move to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that there will be fewer lanes ahead and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be entering the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.
Give pedestrians the right of way.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be prepared to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Pay close attention when driving through intersections or making turns where children may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is especially slippery during wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong direction.
Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers that turning left does not guarantee the right of way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An extra lane has been added.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk area.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
Slow down but do not stop completely.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely at a stop sign. Look for pedestrians and other traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow cars to merge safely.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing downward mean yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road work.
The road ahead makes a sharp turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a sharp turn.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate hazards. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp change in direction ahead.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers:
